Real feedback from real customers who trust us
with their devices.

testimonials.name: Rohit Sharma
testimonials.text: Mera OnePlus 11 ka display toot gaya tha. RepairHub ne bahut quick service di. Original display lagaya aur phone bilkul naya jaisa chal raha hai. Staff bhi bahut polite hai aur service cost bhi reasonable hai.

testimonials.name: Priya Verma
testimonials.text: Mere iPhone 13 me charging issue aa raha tha. RepairHub ne properly diagnose karke charging port replace kiya. Ab phone perfectly charge ho raha hai. Very professional service!

testimonials.name: Amit Patel
testimonials.text: Battery was draining too fast on my Samsung Galaxy S22. Got the battery replaced here. Excellent service and very transparent pricing. Highly recommended!

testimonials.name: Neha Gupta
testimonials.text: I dropped my MacBook and the screen got cracked. RepairHub fixed it within 24 hours. The new screen works flawlessly and the repair cost was much lower than Apple Store.

testimonials.name: Rajesh Kumar
testimonials.text: Water damaged my iPad Pro. I thought it was completely dead, but these guys managed to recover it and save all my important data. Lifesavers!

testimonials.name: Sneha Reddy
testimonials.text: The camera lens on my Google Pixel was scratched. They replaced the lens cover in just 30 minutes while I waited. Great experience overall.

RepairHubFAQ1.description:
Find quick answers to the most common questions
about our mobile repair services.

questions.question: What types of mobile repair services do you offer?
questions.answer: We offer a wide range of mobile repair services including screen replacement, battery replacement, charging port repair, camera repair, speaker issues, water damage repair, software troubleshooting, and more for all major brands.

questions.question: How long does a typical mobile repair take?
questions.answer: Most standard repairs like screen or battery replacements take between 30 to 60 minutes. Complex issues like water damage or motherboard repairs may take 24-48 hours depending on the extent of the damage.

questions.question: Do you use original spare parts?
questions.answer: Yes, we prioritize using 100% original OEM parts. When original parts are not available, we use high-quality certified compatible parts and always inform you before proceeding.

questions.question: Is there a warranty on your repair services?
questions.answer: Absolutely! We provide a minimum 3-month warranty on most of our repairs and replacement parts. If the replaced part fails due to a defect within the warranty period, we will fix it for free.

questions.question: How can I track my repair status?
questions.answer: Once you submit your device, you will receive a unique tracking ID via SMS and email. You can use this ID on our website to check the live status of your repair.

questions.question: Do you offer doorstep pickup and delivery?
questions.answer: Yes, we offer free doorstep pickup and delivery services across the city. Our delivery executive will safely collect your device, and we will return it after the repair is completed.
